package.description: Vovsoft Video Manager is a user-friendly software designed to simplify your video organization experience. With this tool, managing extensive video directories becomes effortless.

en-US.description: Vovsoft Video Manager is a user-friendly software designed to simplify your video organization experience. With this tool, managing extensive video directories becomes effortless.
en-US.longDescription:
Vovsoft Video Manager is a user-friendly software designed to simplify your video organization experience. With this tool, managing extensive video directories becomes effortless. Seamlessly navigate through your collection and swiftly locate specific videos, thanks to its intuitive interface.

What sets this program apart is its ability to generate customizable video thumbnails. You can now visualize your videos at a glance, enabling quick identification and enhancing your overall media management. Whether you're a filmmaker, content creator, or simply someone with a vast video library, this software streamlines your workflow and saves valuable time.

Thumbnail cache: The application stores up to 1,000 generated thumbnails and automatically deletes older thumbnails after that limit is reached.

Say goodbye to the frustration of sifting through endless folders. This software empowers you to organize your videos efficiently, making it an essential companion for anyone dealing with a large volume of video files.
en-US.name: Vovsoft Video Manager
